main_app.app_subtitle: Your Comprehensive Guide for Solar System Design & Setup

voltage.title: Voltage
voltage.analogy: Like water pressure in a pipe; higher pressure pushes electricity stronger.
voltage.practical_tip: Select system voltage (12V, 24V, or 48V) based on system size to minimize loss.

current.title: Electric Current
current.analogy: Like the actual volume of water flowing through the pipe per second.
current.safety_rule: High current requires thicker cables to prevent overheating and fire risks.

power.title: Electrical Power
power.concept: Voltage multiplied by Current (Power = Voltage × Current).

acid.name: Flooded Lead-Acid Batteries
acid.desc: Uses liquid electrolyte and requires regular distilled water refilling. Lower initial cost, but shorter lifespan and maximum 50% recommended depth of discharge.

gel.name: Gel / AGM Batteries (Sealed)
gel.desc: Sealed, leak-proof batteries requiring zero maintenance. Ideal for medium home setups with a recommended 50% depth of discharge.

lithium.name: Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4)
lithium.desc: The top choice for modern systems; features extremely long lifespan (3500+ cycles), rapid charging, and safe discharge depth up to 80%-90%.

mono.name: Monocrystalline Panels
mono.desc: Features a dark black uniform look with top efficiency. Ideal for limited roof spaces and areas with weaker sunlight conditions.

poly.name: Polycrystalline Panels
poly.desc: Recognizable by its blue speckled look. Offers good performance at a lower cost, best suited for larger spaces and average budgets.

flexible.name: Flexible & Lightweight Panels
flexible.desc: Ultra-thin and bendable solar panels, perfect for curved surfaces, RVs, and mobile applications. Easy to carry but has a shorter lifespan.
